channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Pesquisa AtlasIntel revela efeito-Michelle sobre Flávio e o ‘teto eleitoral’ de Lula, dizem analistas
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll shows Lula with 46.3% voting intentions in the 2026 first round, nearly doubling his lead over Flávio Bolsonaro to almost ten points, while Renan Santos emerges as the top-growing alternative candidate at 7.8%. Analysts suggest Michelle Bolsonaro’s video may have harmed Flávio’s campaign, particularly among female voters, and note that high government rejection remains Lula’s main electoral ceiling.

item.title: Em crise com Michelle, Flávio rebate ataques de Paulo Figueiredo contra eleitorado feminino
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro rejected Paulo Figueiredo's remarks about female voters during a women's event hosted by the PL, stating that the ally does not represent his campaign and that his views are not his own. He said he felt offended by Figueiredo's generalizations, although he acknowledged the latter's usefulness on international issues. The conflict arises amid family tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro, who publicly criticized Flávio.

item.title: Flávio critica Michelle após novo post nas redes: ‘Está equivocada quando insinua que estive em festa de Vorcaro’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Michelle Bolsonaro for sharing a video implying his participation in a party promoted by banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating she is 'completely mistaken'. He denied any relationship with Vorcaro beyond financing the film 'Dark Horse' and suggested Michelle may be influenced by third parties. The remarks were made during the first meeting of his pre-campaign targeting female voters, where he also thanked her work at PL Mulher and expressed hope to overcome the tension.

item.title: Repreendido por Flávio, Paulo Figueiredo mantém apoio: "Nada muda"
item.description: Bolsonarist influencer Paulo Figueiredo stated that his support for pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro remains unchanged after the senator publicly repudiated his controversial remarks about women voting poorly. Figueiredo said that what Flávio says is his problem and what he says is his own, emphasizing that he is not part of the campaign but supports him as a voter.

item.title: Flávio repudia fala de Paulo Figueiredo sobre mulheres e afirma que aliado não faz parte de pré-campanha, diz equipe do senador
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro repudiated Paulo Figueiredo's comments about women, calling them completely wrong and stating that Figueiredo is not part of his pre-campaign. The statement came after Figueiredo claimed women vote poorly and attacked former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro over a video criticizing the senator. The meeting with female PL leaders from 20 states aimed to gather proposals for a Women's Action Plan.

item.title: Ronaldo Caiado oficializa Kassab seu pré-candidato a vice na chapa e critica Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD's pre-candidate for president, officially announced Gilberto Kassab, the party's national president, as his running mate in Brasília. as his vice-presidential candidate. He also criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate, during the event in Brasília.

item.title: Lavação de roupa sujo é normal em pré-campanha e não deve atrapalhar Flávio, diz Portinho
item.description: Senator Carlos Portinho (PL-RJ) argued that internal disputes within Bolsonarism, such as the alleged tension between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro, are normal during the pre-campaign phase and should not harm Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy. He downplayed the significance of family conflicts, stating that such 'washing of dirty laundry' is expected in electoral periods and does not indicate weakness in the Bolsonarist base.

item.title: Kassab diz que PSD não conversou com outras siglas para montar chapa; Caiado fala em governabilidade
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, announced he will be Ronaldo Caiado’s running mate in the 2026 presidential ticket, without consulting other parties. He stated there is no crisis in the campaign, emphasizing governability as a priority and criticizing the last 30 years of government for failures in combating corruption, ensuring transparency, and implementing administrative reform.

item.title: Nova operação da PF envolve Sóstenes Cavalcante
item.description: The Federal Police launched an operation targeting parliamentary allowance fraud linked to allies of Deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante (PL-RJ), though he is not a direct target. Governor Ronaldo Caiado confirmed Gilberto Kassab as his running mate for president, aiming to strengthen congressional alliances. Meanwhile, AtlasIntel polls show Lula leading in all second-round scenarios against various opposition figures, including Bolsonaro and his allies.

item.title: Decisão de André Mendonça libera Crivella para concorrer ao Senado
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE granted a preliminary injunction suspending Marcelo Crivella’s conviction by the TRE-RJ, allowing him to run for Senate in Rio de Janeiro. Crivella, who had been barred from office for eight years starting in 2020 due to political and economic abuse of power in the 2016 and 2020 elections (the 'QG da propina' scandal), is polling second with 26%, behind Benedita da Silva (PT) at 34.2%. The ruling argues that upholding the TRE decision could irreversibly hinder his participation in party conventions and candidacy registration, with the case still pending before the Superior Court.

item.title: Em ato sem Michelle, Flávio tenta conter desgaste com mulheres e critica fala de Paulo Figueiredo sobre eleitoras 'votarem mal'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) sought to mitigate damage with female voters following Michelle Bolsonaro's departure as head of PL Women, condemning influencer Paulo Figueiredo's claim that women 'vote badly'. Flávio said he felt offended by the remarks but accepted campaign responsibility for improving communication with women, arguing that female voter resistance reflects campaign shortcomings, not voter fault. The meeting in Brasília was poorly attended due to Michelle's absence and her allies, though Flávio thanked her work and urged unity within the right.

item.title: André Mendonça torna Crivella elegível novamente
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça granted a temporary injunction restoring Marcelo Crivella’s eligibility, allowing him to run for Senate in 2026. The ruling cited proximity to party conventions and risk of irreparable harm, preserving the appeal process. Crivella had been barred since October 2024 over the 'QG da Propina' corruption scheme.

item.title: STF impõe derrota parcial ao Congresso e amplia prazo de prescrição de ações de improbidade
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court struck down, by a vote of 7 to 3, a provision in the 2021 Administrative Improbity Law reform that halved the statute of limitations for such actions, instead establishing a maximum 20-year deadline for their processing. The ruling also expanded the penalty of loss of public office, invalidated restrictions on asset freezes and political rights of those under investigation, and affirmed that proof of intent (dolo) is required to establish administrative improbity.

item.title: Em reação a Flávio, deputado petista quer criminalizar traição à pátria
item.description: Deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) introduced a bill to criminalize treason against the homeland in response to the public exchange of letters between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio. The proposal aims to penalize actions deemed harmful to national sovereignty.

item.title: Nunca estive em festinha de astronauta de Vorcaro, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied attending the 'astronaut party of Vorcaro' during a breakfast meeting with women in Brasília's Lago Sul on July 1, 2026. He expressed respect for Michelle Bolsonaro and criticized a potential fourth PT term, amid ongoing family tensions following mutual accusations of disrespect. The event included female deputies and PL leaders such as Rogério Marinho and Carlos Portinho.

item.title: PF cita falta de servidores e pede a Mendonça mais prazo para concluir análise de material apreendido em investigação que menciona Lulinha
item.description: The Federal Police requested additional time from Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça to complete the analysis of seized material in an INSS fraud investigation, citing staff shortages and the large volume of equipment. The probe mentions Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Lula, as a possible hidden partner of lobbyist 'Careca do INSS,' though his defense denies any wrongdoing. Lulinha has not been charged or named in any criminal action to date.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Flávio aciona Comissão de Ética contra ministro das Relações Exteriores
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, filed an ethics complaint with the Presidency's Ethics Commission against Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira, arguing that the ministry's use of the phrase 'traitors of the Fatherland' in an official statement about U.S. tariffs constitutes inappropriate partisan political content. Marinho claims the post violates principles of neutrality and impersonality in public service and requests an investigation into potential breaches of the Federal High Administration Code of Conduct. He emphasizes that the Itamaraty must uphold institutional moderation and sobriety, avoiding involvement in domestic political debates.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz reunião com mulheres sem Michelle nem Damares após crise por vídeo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) met with a group of women on January 1, 2026, in an effort to build a positive agenda with female voters, following a family crisis involving his stepmother, former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro. The meeting took place without Michelle or Senator Damares Alves, indicating a strategic move to distance himself from internal Bolsonaro clan conflicts and focus on a women-oriented platform. The initiative comes as Flávio positions himself as a pre-candidate for the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Caiado anuncia Kassab como vice e diz que Flávio perderia para Lula no 2º turno
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado officially announced Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, as his vice-presidential running mate for the 2026 election. Caiado stated the partnership confirms the irreversibility of his candidacy and claimed he is the only one capable of defeating Lula in a runoff.

item.title: Democracia representativa com o chapéu alheio?
item.description: The Lula government proposes using resources from compulsory amendments for participatory budgeting, but this confuses distinct mechanisms: parliamentary amendments are instruments of representative democracy that allow lawmakers to represent local interests and be electorally accountable. Transferring this decision to participatory budgeting breaks the accountability link between representatives and constituents, turning a legislative tool into a popular decision without clear responsibility. This measure inappropriately redefines the function of parliamentary amendments, weakening representative democracy by 'doing politics with someone else's hat'.

item.title: Moraes pede nova posição da PGR sobre arma de Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes has ordered the PGR and Bolsonaro's defense to respond within 48 hours to the DF Civil Police report confirming the seized Glock 9 mm pistol belonged to Bolsonaro, per Army Sigma records. The weapon was found with Sergeant Estácio Leite da Silva Filho, charged with illegal possession of a restricted-use firearm, and the case is now under penal execution review, potentially affecting Bolsonaro's humanitarian house arrest. The defense claims the weapon was properly registered, that Bolsonaro was never ordered to surrender it, and that his security team only tested it for a malfunction.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: O divórcio de Michelle com o PL de Bolsonaro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro distanced herself from PL Mulher, a move that could affect the presidential campaign of her son, Flávio Bolsonaro. The Meio-Dia em Brasília program also highlighted new messages from Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) to the Lula government's base in Congress, suggesting potential tensions within the governing coalition.

item.title: Governo Lula diz aos EUA que tarifaço prejudica americanos e reduz espaço de negociação
item.description: The Lula government plans to inform the USTR that the proposed tariff hike against Brazil will harm American interests and shrink the space for bilateral trade negotiations. The move aims to warn Washington about the collateral effects of tariffs on supply chains and Brazilian exports. The goal is to keep dialogue open and avoid an escalation of protectionism.

item.title: Vídeo de Michelle 'ajuda' Jaques Wagner, e Flávio Bolsonaro utiliza Copa para se afastar de desgaste, mostra pesquisa
item.description: A video by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro and highlighting internal divisions in the PL, generated 20.2 million interactions and dominated political discourse between June 22–28, accounting for 12% of all political actor posts. Meanwhile, Flávio Bolsonaro used the World Cup to distance himself from recent pre-candidacy wear and tear, while the PF action against Senator Jaques Wagner (PT) lost visibility amid the family controversy.

item.title: Janja critica fala de Figueiredo de que “mulheres votam mal”
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva criticized, without naming him, journalist and right-wing influencer Paulo Figueiredo's statement that 'women vote poorly,' during the 1st National Conference on Sustainable Development Goals in Brasília. She emphasized that women are the majority of the population and capable of leading national development, advocating for their equal participation in politics and society. The critique came after praising former Minister Marina Silva and before resuming her speech on gender equality and sustainable development.

item.title: Esta terça (30) é o último dia para exibição de propaganda partidária em 2026
item.description: On Tuesday (30), the final day of free partisan propaganda broadcasts on radio and open television for the 2026 elections takes place, as per the electoral calendar. The PL, PSD, and PT parties are airing inserts today, with the PT receiving 1 minute and PL and PSD each receiving 2 minutes of airtime. The allocation of time was established by TSE Ordinance No. 460/2025, which governs free partisan propaganda in the first semester of election years.

item.title: Em seu 3º mandato, Lula acumula 124 entrevistas exclusivas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has given 124 exclusive interviews since the start of his third term in 2023, peaking in 2024 with 43 interviews. In 2026, an election year, he has conducted 17 interviews in the first half—12 with Brazilian outlets and 5 with foreign media—where television accounted for the largest share. His media strategy aligns with heightened public appearances tied to infrastructure deliveries, social program launches, and domestic and international travel amid the electoral contest.

item.title: Lula teria 48,8% dos votos contra 42,3% de Flávio no 2º turno, aponta pesquisa Atlas
item.description: The Atlas/Bloomberg poll shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leading with 48.8% of voting intentions against 42.3% for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in a hypothetical runoff, maintaining a 6.5-point lead. Lula also leads in all first-round scenarios tested.

item.title: Lula pode gravar inserção com Jerônimo, Jaques e Rui em meio à crise do Master
item.description: President Lula may record electoral inserts alongside Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues, Minister of the Civil House Rui Costa, and Senator Jaques Wagner during his visit to Salvador this Wednesday (July 1st). The decision will be made after his arrival in the state, and the material aims to support PT allies amid Jaques Wagner's political crisis linked to the Banco Master investigation.

item.title: Lula dobra a sua vantagem sobre Flávio no 1º turno, mostra pesquisa AtlasIntel/Bloomberg
item.description: Lula doubles his lead over Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round, increasing from a 5-point gap in April to nearly 10 points in June, with 46.3% versus 36.6%. In the second-round simulation, Lula leads 48.8% to 42.3%, reversing the technical tie from April. The poll reflects the impact of the Bolsonaro clan’s internal crisis, following a critical video by Michelle Bolsonaro against her stepson Flávio.

item.title: Aécio Neves é rejeitado por 54% dos eleitores, diz pesquisa
item.description: An AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll released on July 1, 2026 shows Aécio Neves (PSDB) with 54% rejection, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 53% and Lula (PT) at 48.6%. Aécio and Flávio are technically tied within the 1 percentage point margin of error. The survey interviewed 4,999 people nationwide from June 26–30, 2026, with 95% confidence and TSE registration BR-04582/2026.

item.title: Julho traz restrições a candidatos à reeleição em anúncios de obras
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has barred pre-candidates running for re-election from participating in public works inaugurations starting this Saturday (July 5), aiming to ensure equal conditions in the 2026 elections. São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) accelerated deliveries such as the Line 6-Orange subway and Washington Luís station on Line 17-Gold before the deadline, noting that while he cannot personally inaugurate projects, his secretaries may do so on behalf of the government. He has invested an extra R$ 3.7 billion in the Orange Line’s first phase but keeps documents justifying the additional cost under secrecy.

item.title: Lula é aprovado por 45,9% e desaprovado por 52,3%, diz pesquisa
item.description: The AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll conducted from June 26 to 30, 2026 shows that 45.9% of Brazilian voters approve of President Lula’s administration, while 52.3% disapprove, with a 1 percentage point margin of error. Only 39.7% rate the government as 'good' or 'excellent', compared to 48.3% who view it as 'bad' or 'terrible'. The survey took place shortly after the ninth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, which targeted Lula’s ally Jaques Wagner, former Senate government leader.

item.title: Renan Santos cresce na AtlasIntel, mas menos do que campanha esperava
item.description: Renan Santos registers 7.8% voting intention in the latest AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll, a 0.9-point increase since May, within the margin of error. The growth fell short of campaign expectations, which had tracked him at 8% to 9%. Lula leads with 46.3%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 36.6% and Santos in third.

item.title: Rui Costa e Jaques Wagner lideram corrida ao Senado na Bahia
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey released on July 1, 2026 shows Rui Costa (PT) leading the Bahia Senate race with 50.6% voting intentions, followed by Jaques Wagner (PT) at 36.7%. Conducted between June 27–30 among 1,500 respondents across 64 municipalities in Bahia, the poll has a 2.6 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Registered with the TSE under BA-04848/2026, the study cost R$45,000 and was funded by Bahia Notícias.

item.title: AtlasIntel: 52,3% desaprovam Lula. 48,3% acham governo ruim ou péssimo
item.description: According to an AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll released on July 1, 52.3% of Brazilian voters disapprove of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government, while 45.9% approve and 1.8% are undecided. Disapproval has risen slightly from April (53%) and March (54%) after a period of decline from June to December last year. The government is rated as 'bad' or 'terrible' by 48.3% of respondents, with the worst ratings among 16-24 year olds (61.9%) and the best among those over 60 (50.4% rating it 'good' or 'excellent').

item.title: Lula amplia vantagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro em nova rodada da AtlasIntel
item.description: Lula expands his lead over Flávio Bolsonaro to 11 percentage points in the first round, according to the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll released July 1, with 47.2% versus 36.2%. Renan Santos emerges for the first time in sole third place with 7.8%, while government approval dropped to 45.9%. In a runoff, Lula defeats all opponents, leading Bolsonaro by 6.5 points.

item.title: Ministros de Lula deram 267 entrevistas no 1º semestre de 2026
item.description: In the first half of 2026, the 38 ministers of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government granted 267 exclusive interviews, while Lula himself gave 17 individual interviews to the media. First Lady Janja Lula da Silva was interviewed twice. Minister of the General Secretariat of the Presidency, Guilherme Boulos (Psol), led with 42 interviews, surpassing the president in media exposure. Seventeen ministers who left office during the period gave 52 interviews, with former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad and former Chief of Staff Rui Costa each recording seven. Seven ministers did not give any exclusive interviews.

item.title: ACM Neto lidera disputa pelo governo da Bahia no 1º turno
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey released on July 1, 2026, shows ACM Neto (União Brasil) leading the Bahia gubernatorial race with 49.2% voting intention in the first round, ahead of incumbent Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) at 37.5%. The poll interviewed 1,500 people across 64 municipalities from June 27–30, 2026, with a 2.6 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Em ano eleitoral, Lula dá 17 entrevistas exclusivas
item.description: In the first half of 2026, President Lula granted 17 exclusive interviews, slightly more than in the same period of 2025 (16) but fewer than in 2024 (21), despite the election year. Interviews were predominantly with Brazilian outlets (12), including international media such as The Washington Post and El País. Lula maintained a similar interview rhythm to 2025, emphasizing social program announcements and retaining a lead in polls over his main rival, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Jogos de hoje, quarta, 1º de julho: onde assistir futebol ao vivo e horários
item.description: On Wednesday, July 1, 2026, the FIFA World Cup 2026 will feature three key matches: England vs. Democratic Republic of the Congo at 1:00 PM (CazéTV), Belgium vs. Senegal at 5:00 PM (TV Globo, SBT, Sportv, N Sports, ge tv, CazéTV), and United States vs. Bosnia and Herzegovina at 9:00 PM (CazéTV). The content mentions Neymar, Lula, and Cristiano Ronaldo as figures involved in tournament controversies, but there is no direct connection to the 2026 Brazilian elections.

item.title: Justiça italiana analisa extradição de Carla Zambelli no caso da perseguição com arma de fogo
item.description: Italian justice has begun the extradition hearing for former deputy Carla Zambelli over illegal firearm possession and unlawful coercion with a weapon, stemming from a 2022 incident in São Paulo where she chased a man while armed. Zambelli did not attend the hearing in Rome. Minister Gilmar Mendes of Brazil’s STF previously sent assurances to Italy, affirming the conviction’s validity by wide majorities (9-2 and 10-1) and stating the process was regular and free of defects that would block extradition.

item.title: Podcast: o peso de Minas Gerais na eleição e a indefinição de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no estado
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro visited Minas Gerais in June, highlighting their struggles to secure strong support in the state, which is Brazil’s second-largest electoral college and historically pivotal for national victory. Despite their visits, neither managed to establish a solid electoral base in Minas, reflecting the state’s fragmented politics and unpredictable voter behavior.

item.title: PT e PL ignoram legislação eleitoral e impulsionam críticas a opositores
item.description: The PL and PT violated electoral law by boosting attacks against opponents on social media, spending at least R$277,000 and reaching over 39.1 million impressions. This practice, prohibited by Electoral Justice, aims to amplify negative content against electoral rivals. The case occurs in the context of Brazil’s 2026 elections.

item.title: Como fica o mapa do metrô de SP com a inauguração da Linha 6-Laranja
item.description: The first section of São Paulo's Line 6-Orange metro line opens after an eight-year delay, featuring six stations. Service begins on July 2 with limited weekday hours and no fare collection during this assisted operation phase. The metropolitan transport map will be updated to include the new stations and the Washington Luís station on Line 17-Gold, which introduces Brazil's first 'Y'-shaped rail configuration.

item.title: Empresários do agro paulista doam R$ 1 milhão para partido de Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo agribusiness entrepreneurs donated nearly R$1 million to the Republicans party in June, ahead of party conventions, to support Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’ campaign, which has offered land regularization and fiscal benefits to the sector. The largest contribution came from Luiz Zillo Neto (Usina Quatá) with R$350,000, followed by Carlos Dinucci and Antonio Eduardo Tonielo Filho, each donating R$100,000. Among the donors is João Luiz Quagliato Neto, convicted in 2023 for slave labor on a farm in Pará.

item.title: Craques do Cruzeiro convocam torcida para jogão contra Grêmio no DF
item.description: Cruzeiro and Grêmio will face off in a preparatory friendly on July 12 at 5:00 PM at Arena Mané Garrincha in Brasília, organized by Metrópoles Sports. Stars Fagner and Lucas Silva urged fans to attend, while striker Kaio Jorge, who has scored 45 goals in 95 appearances for Cruzeiro since joining from Juventus in 2024, is highlighted as one of Brazil’s top attackers and aims for the 2026 scoring title. Tickets are now available for the match.

item.title: Dosimetria, Uberização e mais: STF encerra semestre em sessão nesta quarta e casos de repercussão devem ficar para agosto, veja lista
item.description: The STF concludes its semester with the final session of judgments this Wednesday (1st), focusing on the validity of provisions in the Administrative Improbity Law. High-repercussion cases — including 'Uberization' (worker-platform relations), 'Dosimetry' (reduced penalties for antidemocratic acts), and Rio de Janeiro succession — are postponed until August after the recess. Rapporteur Alexandre de Moraes maintained the suspension of the Dosimetry Law, while the PGR opposed this measure.

item.title: Advogado do Prerrogativas vai coordenar campanha de Lula em SP
item.description: Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, a founding member of the Prerrogativas group, has been appointed to coordinate Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election campaign in São Paulo. He will also support Fernando Haddad’s bid for state governor, aligning the national campaign with the state-level race. Aurélio stated that São Paulo is decisive for Lula’s victory and highlighted the strength and experience of the PT ticket.

item.title: PL aciona TSE contra Lula por discurso de ódio e racismo em SC
item.description: The PL filed a representation with the TSE against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, alleging he spread hate speech and racism against Santa Catarina’s population during an official event in Itajaí, and engaged in premature electoral propaganda. The petition requests fines, a ban on repeating such statements, and referral to the Electoral Prosecutor’s Office and the Attorney General’s Office. The Planalto has not yet issued an official response.
